body:
## Summary
The lane record is the only reproducibility contract for gitignored pixels, and its parameter set is written four times: two argparse blocks, check_resume's 12 elif branches and replay_argv. The copies already disagree. An interrupted reference lane replays without --refs, a clip lane never replays its --hero, and the module's own default LOCATION describes a different hangar. Declare the params once in a LANE_PARAMS table (record key, legacy aliases, CLI flag, type, default, strict-on-resume, kind). Derive argparse, the record writer, the resume guard, replay_argv and the lane directory name from it.

## Description
lane_record.py gains LANE_PARAMS = {'stills': [...], 'clips': [...]}, add_lane_args(ap, kind), lane_dir(kind, **p) / params_from_dir, and a table-driven check_resume and replay_argv. Its CHARACTER/LOCATION copies are deleted. Records take the scene clauses from the caller, and a missing clause fails loudly. consistency.build_arg_parser and motion.main call add_lane_args, and run_lane calls lane_dir. Flags that are not lane params (--timeout) stay local. No tracked lane.json is rewritten.

## Flow
- Snapshot today's replay_argv for the 8 tracked lanes ([guard] case).
- Write the 6 behaviour cases red in lane-params.probe.spec.ts (python -c spawn, the lane-record.probe.spec.ts pattern).
- Introduce LANE_PARAMS. Derive replay_argv first (cases 1-3), then check_resume (case 4), then scene defaults and lane_dir (cases 5-6).
- Swap the two argparse blocks to add_lane_args; re-run selftest.py and both lane probes.

## Expected impact
The next lane knob becomes one table row instead of four synchronized edits. Every recorded param is guaranteed to replay and to be guarded on resume. Two silent replay refusals and one false scene description close, and check_resume shrinks from 73 lines to a loop.

## Evaluation
Claim: lane parameters have one authority and every recorded param round-trips through replay and resume.
Before: 0 of 6 behaviour cases pass (2 guards green)
After: 6 of 6, guards still green
Method: gate - tests/golden-path/lane-params.probe.spec.ts in the Node probe lane, plus python pipeline/foundry/selftest.py
Result: better
Gate: architecture

body:
## Summary
This card adopts the decided, unbuilt C11 next stage (critic-2026-10-07.md:45, :896-948), fixes all three acceptance defects the critic recorded and answers both of its open questions. Accuracy, as distinct from agreement, rests on two hand-written truth files. The consistency lanes already dictate shot size, angle and focus for every render and throw the labels away. This stage turns each dictated clause into a labelled spec, has run_lane mint a lane-qualified truth sidecar per shot, and has score.py read sidecars by truth_id so labels stop colliding across lanes.

## Description
New stdlib-only craft_spec.py: validate(spec) against the schema.FIELDS enums, a phrase->value lexicon whose contested phrases route to _ungraded, digest(spec) and truth_id(lane_dir, shot). In consistency.py, SHOTS_SPEC/ZOOM_SPEC become (name, clause, spec) with each clause byte-identical. run_lane writes <lane-dir>/<shot>.truth.json in the frames/truth house shape, plus basis, seed, spec_digest and truth_id, and adds spec_digest to the write_shot params (additive to lane-record/2). score.py still resolves truth from frames/truth/<stem>.json and now also from sidecars by truth_id. It shows basis per row, scores only dictated+confirmed and counts disputed under generator compliance. Blind admission (truth_admit.py) stays stage 2 because it spends the seat.

## Flow
- Write cases 1-7 red in truth-sidecar.probe.spec.ts (python -c spawn, no GPU).
- craft_spec.py: validate, lexicon, digest, truth_id (cases 1, 4).
- Label SHOTS_SPEC/ZOOM_SPEC and assert byte-identical prompts against the six tracked lanes (case 2).
- run_lane sidecar write (case 3), then score.py resolution and basis tables (cases 5-7).

## Expected impact
The truth population grows from 2 frames x <=5 fields to 3 graded fields on every generated shot of every future lane, at zero labelling cost. Each label is admitted only through confirmation, so a request is never scored as a label. Generator disobedience and annotator error become separate numbers, and lanes stop overwriting each other's truth.

## Evaluation
Claim: generated shots mint lane-qualified, digest-pinned truth that score.py reads without collisions or silent staleness.
Before: 0 of 7 behaviour cases pass (guard green)
After: 7 of 7, guard green
Method: gate - tests/golden-path/truth-sidecar.probe.spec.ts in the Node probe lane, plus python pipeline/foundry/selftest.py
Result: better
Gate: architecture
